data.title: Saudi-Turkish Cooperation Agreement to Empower Wrestling Champions, Improve Their Performance
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi and Turkish wrestling federations have signed a cooperation agreement aimed at developing the sport of wrestling and benefiting from each other's technical and training expertise.
    President of the Saudi Wrestling Federation Fahad Alfarraj and President of the Turkish Wrestling Federation Taha Akgül represented their respective federations at the signing ceremony in Riyadh.
    The agreement aims to support athletes and improve their technical performance through joint training camps, the exchange of expertise, and increased participation in sporting competitions. It also seeks to expand opportunities for technical exchanges between athletes from the two countries, drawing on specialized expertise to develop their capabilities, enhance their readiness for competitions, and strengthen their presence at international events.
    -- SPA
